messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx + rising p95 latency observed in us-east-1 for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Paging @oncall-sre and #incidents.

oncall-sre: seeing spike starting ~5543210950. 5xx ~9-13% on /v1/generate endpoints. p95 ~1.2s, p50 ~300ms. Dedicated pool control plane logging auth timeouts to STS/IMDS.

sre-jen: confirmed. ELB -> upstream shows 502/504 patterns and a lot of TCP RSTs from natgw. IMDS token refreshes failing intermittently for some instances.

eng-runtime-alex: KV cache and GPU metrics look healthy. This is cascading from slowed token fetches causing worker retries and request stalls.

oncall-sre: mitigation proposal: 1) enable cross-region routing for new sessions away from us-east-1 (prefer eu-west-1), 2) temp reduce auth retry multiplier to avoid fanout, 3) short TTL token cache for dedicated workers, 4) customer comms for high-touch accounts. Anyone object?

ops-lead-maya: +1. I'll open AWS ticket and attach natgw/ELB logs. Also recommend disabling long polling on problematic hosts.

eng-platform-raj: suggest adding a per-host circuit-breaker on STS/IMDS calls to fail fast and return 429 to clients rather than cascading 5xx.

support-liam: prepping a targeted customer note for customers with heavy regional affinity. Will queue once we confirm routing flip.

eng-runtime-alex: applying routing rule now:

```
# switch fallback target for us-east-1
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --src us-east-1 --dst eu-west-1 --scope hosted,dedicated --commit
```

incident-bot: automated action: routing change applied by eng-runtime-alex at 5543211020. Suppressing duplicate alerts for the next 10m.

oncall-sre: monitoring — hosted error rate fell to ~4% within 45s. Dedicated pools improved for new sessions but existing long-lived sessions still show token refresh failures.

eng-runtime-alex: rolling restart of 4 dedicated workers with TOKEN_CACHE_TTL=60s to reduce STS calls.

sre-jen: after token cache and routing changes, overall customer-facing errors down to <1% impact. p95 in fallback region ~360ms.

ops-lead-maya: AWS case opened: 9876543210. AWS acknowledged localized control plane/IMDS flakiness in the region; investigating.

support-liam: sent interim updates to top affected customers: short note + status link. Including ask for any regional-only constraints.

cs-ash: one customer reported embeddings failures earlier; they verified traffic succeeded after fallback. Collecting request ids for post-incident timeline.

eng-platform-raj: next steps (action items): 1) implement host-level circuit-breaker on IMDS calls (PR queued), 2) add routing heuristic to prefer local region but fallback faster (<10s), 3) add retry budget enforcement to prevent fanout to STS.

sre-jen: agree. Also include runbook updates: how to flip fallback and roll TTL cache. Will draft RCA with timestamps and customer impact.

oncall-sre: handing off to night oncall @oncall-sre-night at 5543211460. Mitigations active, pager remains open for escalation. Keep thread for final incident summary and RCA attachments.
